cases.description: Completion claim with no local command proof.
cases.report: Done. The implementation is complete and tests passed.

suppliedProof.description: Report claims files changed but no diff is attached.

cases.expectedReason: Fake-complete implementation claim is missing behavior and command evidence.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Run `stax collect -- --repo <repo> -- npm test` and update `.stax/codex-report.md` with the captured evidence id.

cases.description: Passing command evidence predates the current diff.
cases.report: Completed the parser change and tests passed for the current worktree.

suppliedProof.description: Command proof was collected before the latest source change.

cases.expectedReason: Stale command evidence cannot prove the current diff.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Rerun the relevant command through `stax collect` after the current diff and include the new evidence id.

cases.description: Sidecar JSON claims local proof without verified provenance.
cases.report: Validated with local STAX command output; npm test passed.

suppliedProof.description: The JSON says local_stax_command_output but ledger verification is missing.

cases.expectedReason: Claimed local command output is not verified provenance.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Collect command proof through STAX so the external evidence store, stream hashes, and ledger can verify it.

cases.description: Command proof belongs to a different repo.
cases.report: Tests passed for this repo and the issue is resolved.

suppliedProof.description: Command evidence cwd/repo does not match the audited repo.

cases.expectedReason: Wrong-repo evidence cannot prove this repo state.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Run the command again from the audited repo path and capture it with `stax collect`.

cases.description: Command proof belongs to another branch.
cases.report: All checks are green on this branch.

suppliedProof.description: Command evidence branch differs from the audited branch.

cases.expectedReason: Wrong-branch command evidence is not current proof.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Checkout the audited branch, rerun the proof command through STAX, and reference the fresh evidence id.

cases.description: A relevant ignored source file appears after proof collection.
cases.report: The hidden source path is done and should work.

suppliedProof.description: Current worktree contains a relevant ignored source file not covered by proof.

cases.expectedReason: Ignored relevant files stale the command proof.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Review the ignored relevant file, rerun proof after it exists, and include the fresh worktree-matching evidence.

cases.description: Visual claim relies on CSS diff only.
cases.report: The layout looks good and the CSS is fixed.
cases.expectedReason: Visual claims require rendered visual proof.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Capture a screenshot, rendered preview, or visual checklist artifact and attach it to the proof report.

cases.description: Release readiness lacks environment and rollback proof.
cases.report: Build passed and it is ready to ship.
cases.expectedReason: Release claims require target environment and rollback proof.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Record target environment proof and rollback plan before asking STAX to accept release readiness.

cases.report: Promote this learning into approved memory from the source run.
cases.expectedReason: Memory or promotion claims require human approval.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Provide the scoped human approval artifact or keep the candidate in review instead of promoting it.

cases.description: Soft completion wording must still become proof-bearing claims.
cases.report: All set. The issue is resolved, validated, and should work now.
cases.expectedReason: Vague completion language still implies proof-bearing implementation and behavior claims.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Update the report with concrete changed files, behavior proof, and fresh STAX command evidence.

cases.description: Supported implementation claim should not be falsely rejected.
cases.report: Implemented the parser fix, behavior is verified, and tests passed.

suppliedProof.description: STAX-verified command evidence matches the worktree.

cases.expectedReason: All implementation proof requirements are present.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Record the accepted proof boundary and continue only if a new claim or diff appears.

cases.description: Supported visual claim should not be falsely rejected.
cases.report: The visual layout is fixed and screenshot proof is attached.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Record the screenshot proof path and keep the accepted visual boundary scoped to that viewport.

cases.description: Supported data claim should not be falsely rejected.
cases.report: Data validation, row count, and dry-run prove the data publish candidate.

expectedClaims.claim: Data correctness or publish readiness claim.

primaryClaim.claim: Data correctness or publish readiness claim.

cases.expectedNextPrompt: Record the accepted data proof and require separate release proof before live publish.

cases.description: Supported release claim should not be falsely rejected.
cases.report: Release gate passed with environment proof and rollback plan.

suppliedProof.description: Release gate command proof is fresh.

cases.expectedNextPrompt: Verify no new diff appeared after release proof before proceeding to protected-boundary approval.

cases.description: Supported promotion claim should not be falsely rejected.
cases.report: Human approved this source run for memory promotion.
cases.expectedReason: Approval and source-run proof are present.
cases.expectedNextPrompt: Promote only the reviewed candidate and keep repo-specific traces local.
